name: zendesk-mcp
description: Sets up the Measurabl Zendesk connector for Claude Desktop from the Code tab on a Mac. One command installs a prebuilt copy of the Zendesk MCP server, registers it with Claude Desktop, and restarts Claude; each person then signs in with Measurabl SSO (Okta) on first use. No credentials ship with the plugin. Usage: /zendesk-mcp:setup [install|verify|update|uninstall].
